scope: Selected factual and high-change references rechecked against primary publishers. The complete reading retains the author's 27 October 2026 source edition; this register does not claim a fresh review of every source.

checks.result: The publisher's June quarter 2026 page supports 27.1 million domestic overnight trips and 74.2 million domestic day trips. Counts describe trips, not unique people.
The operator provides date-specific base timetables and directs travellers to its booking and service-status pages for actual availability. This site republishes no departure times or fares.
The ACCC describes consumer guarantees and circumstance-dependent travel remedies. The reading does not promise an automatic refund for every disruption.
The OAIC's current APP overview covers collection, use, disclosure, accountability, integrity, access and correction for covered organisations and agencies.

Queensland Government's organising-committee page identifies Games planning, event coordination and volunteer recruitment as committee responsibilities. No Aura recruitment or partnership is established.
The ACCC-hosted Lonergan Research report is dated February 2025; the 94% smartphone observation belongs to its 2024 fieldwork and 14-and-older population, not a new 2026 survey.
The eSafety hub states that the social media age restrictions took effect on 10 December 2025. This is policy context, not an endorsement of the proposal.
